# `kaolin/io/PointCloudIO.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/io/PointCloudIO.js`

PointCloudIO.js — Point cloud import/export (PLY, PCD, XYZ) Pure JS parsers/writers for point cloud formats. Outputs: Float32Array positions (stride 3) + optional normals/colors. Compatible with: - PointCloudOps.js - MeshToPoints.js / PointsToMesh.js - Particle system (direct spawn from loaded points)

## Functions
